# knex_dart

> knex_dart is a Dart SQL query builder inspired by Knex.js. The core package generates dialect-correct SQL; live database access requires a driver package (knex_dart_postgres, knex_dart_sqlite, etc.).

Important notes:
- `knex_dart` is the core builder — it has no database connectivity on its own.
- Install a driver package to execute queries against a real database.
- SQL feature support varies by dialect; consult the database support page.
- Bindings are always positional. Use `toSQL()` to inspect generated SQL without executing.
